# Resomi
Resomi are a small avian-like species that hail from an icy world. They have a set of ammonia-based biology unlike most other species.
## Benefits
- They are immune to all cold damage, and are unbothered by the cold. - They can digest raw meat and other uncooked animal proteins.
## Drawbacks
- They take 30% more Heat and 15% more Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage. - They find temperatures most other species find comfortable to be unbearably hot, and their movement becomes sluggish in the cold. - They have ammonia-based blood.
## Special
- Due to their small size, they can be stuffed into duffelbags. - Their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage.
